rationale: The replication successfully reproduces all four headline sub-claims: linear-in-h scaling (exponent=1.0000), coefficient proportional to octupolar order parameter m (R²=1.000), correct geometric factor 1/√3 for [111] direction, and hysteresis below T_O. Agreement is exact because these are symmetry-dictated identities rather than fitted parameters. Coverage is limited because the replication does not test microscopic coupling constants (g_O), the full phase diagram with T_O≈0.65K, other field directions ([100]/[110]), or material-specific magnitudes—only the internal logical consistency of the Landau theory framework.
